text:
maria: Quick thread to lock pilot picks for the long-term routing/isolation roadmap. Need two pilots + one low-risk ops experiment.
aj: +1. Leaning toward one revenue-driven hard-isolation tenant and one latency-focused soft slice.
kiran: Routing tradeoff: route-by-tenant gives per-tenant policies but requires ~2 sprint work on the policy engine. route-by-region is quicker but coarser.
devin: Ops estimate: hard-isolation pilot = ~18h automation + reserved capacity sizing; soft slice + prefix-cache = ~6-8h.
rebecca: Sales: FinLedger (EU) needs residency & audit logs; renewal in 6w. Strong commercial case.
sam: Product note: TinyNews (US) is latency-sensitive, low volume. Good test for prefix caching + lite variants.
maria: Proposed pilots: Pilot A = FinLedger (hard isolation, EU, KMS + audit). Pilot B = TinyNews (soft isolation with prefix-cache, US). Experiment = prefix-cache rollup for low-volume tenants.
aj: Acceptance criteria (template): isolation mode; p95/p99 SLOs; fallback variant list; cost delta estimate; rollback runbook; telemetry hooks; compliance checklist.
kiran: Migration steps: 1) policy templates & reserved pool sizing 2) canary at 5% traffic 3) monitor + verify SLOs 4) scale to 100%. Each step has go/no-go checks.
devin: Runbook stub (ops): curl /ops/fallback to force tenant onto fallback variant; verify via /ops/tenant-status. I'll PR automation.
rebecca: I'll prepare customer-facing 2-line blurbs and mark contract constraints for FinLedger.
maria: Owners: Rebecca (commercial + customer notes), AJ (perf sims + cost delta), Kiran (routing tasks), Devin (runbook + automation), Maria (packaging + leadership deck).
opsbot: Heads up: staging KMS tests flapping; tagging @devin.
devin: I'll triage tomorrow AM.
aj: Perf sims show hard isolation adds ~35ms p99 on current infra; prefix-cache reduces p99 by ~20ms for small tenants. I'll post numbers.
maria: Timeline: artifacts by Friday EOD, leadership review Monday 10am. Share doc links here when ready.
rebecca: Draft live: https://rwd.in/drive/pilot-pack-v2 (uploaded).
kiran: Routing impact spreadsheet uploaded.
devin: Runbook PR opened: https://rwd.in/pr/1248.
rebecca: Will also list pricing flexibility for FinLedger in the doc.
maria: Great work. We'll finalize picks Monday. :thumbsup:
